description: pkix-path-builder/tests/integration.rs:247-253 — The adversarial pool test directly mutates ca.tbs_certificate.issuer and ca.tbs_certificate.subject_public_key_info.subject_public_key to create synthetic clones. These mutations produce Rust-object-level modifications that bypass DER consistency — the tbs_certificate fields are inconsistent with the outer certificate's DER signature. This is acceptable in a path-BUILDER test (build_path only does name matching, not signature verification), but the comment should explicitly note that these certs are structurally invalid for validate_path purposes, and the test should NOT pass them to validate_path. The test already avoids calling validate_path with these mutated certs, but the comment should be explicit.
title: pkix-path-builder test mutates cert fields directly (bypasses DER)
